alerts.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 19 at 10:12AM PST until November 19 at 12:15PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Orange County in southwestern California...

* WHEN...Until 1215 PM PST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1012 AM PST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.75 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Ana

alerts.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 19 at 1:33AM PST until November 20 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Surf of 3 to 5 feet. Sets to 7 feet along west-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 6 AM PST today through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Increased risk for rip currents. Areas of coastal
flooding possible during high tide each morning along
boardwalks and parking lots.
